name: 12.7mm Machine Gun
desc: Firing .50 caliber ammunition, the 12.7mm machine gun is effective against aircraft and lightly armored surface targets at ranges of up to 1km (0.61 miles).

name: 12.7mm MG Emplacement
desc: This heavy machine gun mounted on a tripod is low-cost means of defending point targets from light vehicles and low flying helicopters. Its small size and low profile make it difficult to spot from a distance.

name: 12.7mm Rotary Machine Gun
desc: Firing .50 caliber ammunition, the 12.7mm machine gun is effective against aircraft and lightly armored surface targets at ranges of up to 1km (0.61 miles).

name: 120kw Laser
desc: High energy laser weapon designed to intercept missiles and bombs at ranges of up to 15km.

name: 127mm Guided Shell
desc: A 10kg HE warhead housed in a fin-stabilised airframe. Uses canard control for terminal guidance that is provided by an electro-optical seeker head.

name: 155mm Guided Shell
desc: An extended range guided artillery shell, using a combination of inertial navigation and terminal laser guidance to improve its accuracy.

name: 20kw Laser
desc: Point-defence laser designed to intercept approaching missiles from within 2km.

name: 20mm Rotary Cannon
desc: This rotary cannon fires 20mm explosive shells at 6000 rounds per minute, making it highly effective against aerial targets.

name: 23mm AAA Emplacement
desc: This manually aimed static air defense position is a simple and low-cost means of defending point targets from helicopters and other low-flying aircraft. Its small size and low profile make it difficult to spot from a distance.

name: 25mm Autocannon
desc: Allowing a traverse range from -10 to +10 degrees and an elevation range from -20 to +5 degrees, this aimable cannon pod is effective against light armor or aircraft at distances of up to 2000m.

name: 25mm Rotary Cannon
desc: The 25mm rotary cannon fires dual purpose explosive shells, effective against aircraft or moderately armored surface targets.

name: 27mm Autocannon
desc: Slower firing than its rotary counterparts, the 27mm Autocannon packs a heavier punch and is effective against both aircraft and moderately armored surface targets.

name: 30mm Chaingun
desc: This gun shoots 30mm explosive shells effective against armored ground vehicles and buildings at ranges of over 2km (1.3m).

name: 30mm Rotary Cannon
desc: Occupying three structural hardpoints and weighing in at 1.6 tons loaded, this seven-barrelled, twin motor behemoth fires a mixed belt of 30mm armour piercing incendiary & HE rounds at 3000rpm. Can be made effective against the majority of enemy vehicles, buildings, and slow moving aircraft.

name: 35mm Autocannon
desc: The 35mm Autocannon packs a heavier punch than other aerial guns and is effective against many armored surface targets. Its superior ballistics allow it to remain effective at ranges exceeding 3000m.

name: 40mm GMG
desc: Automatic grenade launcher firing low-velocity 40mm explosive rounds, ideal for destroying small buildings or groups of lightly-armored targets

name: 40mm Grenade
desc: Low velocity from short tube, fired more opportunistically by infantry

name: 57mm Cannon
desc: An fast firing, autoloaded 57mm gun, firing high velocity unguided shells. When fired against air targets, the shells use a proximity fuse to deal fragmentation damage.

name: 70mm Light AT
desc: Confined space compatible shoulder fired recoilless rifle

name: 76mm Cannon
desc: An autoloaded 76mm gun, firing fin-stabilised guided projectiles. The gun requires airflow for cooling. It has a maximum firerate of 60RPM for 10 seconds, and can sustain a constant firerate of at least 40 RPM while moving at 500kph

name: 76mm Guided Shell
desc: A 3kg HE warhead housed in a fin-stabilised airframe. Uses canard control for terminal guidance that is provided by an electro-optical seeker head.

name: 80kw Laser
desc: Point-defence laser designed to intercept approaching missiles from within 8km.

name: A-19 Brawler
desc: The Brawler is a reliable and rugged platform built to carry large quantities of precision weapons. Advanced propfan engines combine endurance with respectable speed, while redundant control surfaces, isolated engines, and heavy cockpit armor provide excellent survivability. The A-19 is in its element when attacking convoys of vehicles, distributed short-range air defenses, or vessels operating in coastal waters.

name: AAM-29 Scythe
desc: Using a combination of inertial guidance and terminal radar homing, the Scythe can engage aerial targets at beyond visual range

name: AAM-36 Scimitar
desc: A missile using a ramjet for beyond visual range (BVR) engagement.

name: AeroSentry SPAAG
desc: This self-propelled anti-aircraft gun sports twin 30mm autocannons firing proximity-fused shells, capable of accurately striking fast-moving targets at ranges of over 4000m

name: AFV6 AA
desc: The AFV6 is a fast, lightweight multipurpose armoured vehicle. This is a short range air-defence variant, with a potent 20mm rotary cannon and an IRM-S1 launcher.

name: AFV6 APC
desc: The AFV6 is a fast, lightweight multipurpose armoured vehicle. This is the default variant, an armoured personnel carrier. The increased seating capacity allows it to capture locations faster than other variants.

name: AFV6 AT
desc: The AFV6 is a fast, lightweight multipurpose armoured vehicle. This is an anti-armour variant, equipped with a large, long range multiple ATGM launcher. Internal stores of extra missiles reduce seating capacity substantially.

name: AFV6 IFV
desc: The AFV6 is a fast, lightweight multipurpose armoured vehicle. This variant is an infantry fighting vehicle with a 25mm cannon.

name: AFV8 APC
desc: The AFV8 Armored Personnel Carrier is a fast troop transport with a roof mounted machine gun to counter low-flying aerial threats and soft ground targets

name: AFV8 IFV
desc: This upfit for the AFV8 chassis features a 25mm cannon and anti-armor missile launcher, turning it into a fast infantry fighting vehicle.

name: AFV8 Mobile Air Defense
desc: Featuring 8 IR missile launchers, this air defense system is capable of intercepting missiles and aircraft at a range of up to 5km

name: AGM-48
desc: Effective against ground targets or slow-flying aircraft at ranges of up to 8km, the AGM-48 can maneuver erratically to make interception difficult.

name: AGM-48
desc: Effective against ground targets or slow-flying aircraft at ranges of up to 8km, the AGM-48 can maneuver erratically to make interception difficult.

name: AGM-68
desc: The AGM-68 is a large, optically guided missile capable of destroying structures and heavily armored vehicles. It follows an unpredictable trajectory to avoid interception.

name: AGM-99
desc: This anti-ship missile has a very low altitude cruise profile with a pop-up terminal attack mode designed to penetrate ship defenses. Can be deployed from aircraft or launched from an Argus Class Frigate.

name: AGR-18 Lynchpin
desc: Short range 70mm rocket with a laser guidance package providing limited maneuverability. Launching aircraft must aim at the target and keep it selected to provide guidance.

name: AGR-24 Kingpin
desc: Medium range 127mm rocket with a laser guidance package providing limited maneuverability. Launching aircraft must aim at the target and keep it selected to provide guidance.

name: AIR-2 Genie
desc: Unguided air-to-air rocket with a 1.5kt nuclear warhead and a 12-second time delay fuse. Why is this still in the inventory?

name: Aircraft Revetment
desc: Protected parking area for aircraft, shielded from shrapnel

name: ALM-C450
desc: Flying at subsonic speeds along a terrain-hugging flight path, this cruise missile is difficult to detect and can overwhelm defenses in large numbers.

name: ALND-4 (20kt)
desc: The ALND-4 (Air Launched Nuclear Deterrent) is a long range subsonic cruise missile carrying a tactical nuclear warhead.

name: Ammo Dump
desc: An open stockpile for storing conventional ammunition. Can resupply units within 300m.

name: Annex Class Carrier
desc: An amphibious assault ship which can support rotary wing and V/STOL aircraft operations. It has a well deck from which it can launch landing craft, and it can perform shore bombardment with its 76mm cannon and dual-purpose 40mm point defence guns.

name: ARAD-116
desc: This anti-radiation missile will lock on to radar emissions after launch, making it ideal for attacking SAM sites at beyond visual range.

name: ARAD-45
desc: The ARAD-45 uses the same body as the RAM-45 missile, but with an anti-radiation seeker, which will lock on to radar emissions after launch, making it ideal for attacking SAM sites at medium range.

name: Argus Class Frigate
desc: Bristling with air defense weapons, the Argus class is a missile frigate designed to protect valuable assets from air attack. Capable of locking down airspace in a wide radius, it is an essential component of BDF naval doctrine. The Argus class is fitted with the NL-98 active radar homing missile, capable of engaging datalinked targets at beyond visual ranges.

name: AShM-300
desc: This anti-ship cruise missile can be launched from aircraft or vertically by the Dynamo class Destroyer, using sea-skimming technique and supersonic speeds to penetrate the enemy's air defense systems.

name: AT-145
desc: Short-range anti-tank guided missile designed for knocking out vehicles, emplacements,  and small buildings

name: AT-145 Emplacement
desc: The AT-145 is a short-range anti-tank guided missile designed for knocking out vehicles, emplacements and small buildings.

name: ATP-1
desc: Designed specifically for anti-armor applications, this short range fire-and-forget missile is ideal for penetrating well protected tanks from any angle.

name: Bend D25x45deg 2D
desc: Structural element

name: Bend D25x45deg 4D
desc: Structural element

name: Boltstrike RAM45 Launcher
desc: This transportable air defense missile launcher capable of engaging aerial targets within 15km. It can be deployed by a utility aircraft and obtains target info from a nearby radar.

name: Camo Net 1
desc: Entrenchment

name: Cargo Hook
desc: A cargo hook with a 20m (65ft) line for slinging external loads and recovering downed pilots.

name: CBO-400
desc: This 400kg cluster bomb dispenses 8 GS25 submunitions capable of independently finding and targeting hostile units in the vicinity.

name: CI-22 Cricket
desc: Designed for counter insurgency operations and low-intensity battlefields, the CI-22 Cricket features robust landing gear and short takeoff and landing capability, allowing it to operate from unprepared fields. While lacking in speed and survivability, the CI-22 possesses remarkable agility and the ability to mount an array of weapon types

name: Column 50m
desc: Structural element

name: Concrete barrier
desc: Single Concrete barrier

name: Concrete Pad
desc: Structural element

name: Concrete Wall
desc: Single Concrete wall

name: Concrete Wall 10m
desc: A 10m section of concrete wall

name: Cone D25x20m
desc: Structural element

name: Cone D40x20m
desc: Structural element

name: Cone D40x25m
desc: Structural element

name: Container blue
desc: Single Container

name: Container orange
desc: Single Container

name: Container red
desc: Single Container

name: Container stack
desc: Stacked Containers

name: Container white
desc: Single Container

name: Control Tower
desc: Airbase traffic control tower

name: Cooling Tower
desc: Structural element

name: Cylinder D20x50m
desc: Structural element

name: Cylinder D25x50m
desc: Structural element

name: Demolition Bomb
desc: Heavy thermobaric guided bomb capable of devastating soft targets over a wide area. Best used against buildings or lightly defended groups of vehicles.

name: Dynamo Class Destroyer
desc: This guided missile destroyer is armed with a battery of vertically launched cruise missiles and a 155mm railgun in its forward turret. Its powerful defensive armament of two MMR-S3 batteries, three R9 vertical launchers and four 30mm CIWS turrets, makes the Dynamo class a powerful warship, able to defend a fleet from any threat.

name: Enrichment Plant
desc: Supplies fissile material for nuclear weapons. Having an enrichment plant ensures a steady supply of nuclear warheads.

name: EW-25 Medusa
desc: The EW-25 is a short take-off, vertical landing (STOVL) support aircraft with a variety of powerful electronic warfare systems. Able to triangulate radar positions, jam enemy radar installations, suppress air defences, and even shoot down missiles with a high energy laser, a single Medusa can easily turn the tide of a battle.

name: Eyeball Mk.II
desc: This modified AGM-48 replaces the missile's usual warhead with a panoramic optical sensor suite capable of detecting enemy targets and registering them as contacts on faction datalink

name: FGA-57 Anvil
desc: Firing 57mm proximity fused explosive shells, the Anvil is capable of dealing devastating volleys against both air and land targets

name: Flare Stack
desc: Structural element

name: Flat Platform
desc: Structural element

name: FS-12 Revoker
desc: The FS-12 Revoker is built for agility above all else, capable of extreme maneuvers at almost any speed. Internal weapon bays help reduce drag, allowing supersonic speeds even at low altitudes and with heavy payloads. While less stealthy than newer fighters, the Revoker remains a cost-effective means of establishing air superiority.

name: FS-20 Vortex
desc: A compact and advanced multirole fighter, the Vortex is capable of operating vertically from small carriers and remaining undetected thanks to outstanding stealth characteristics. While fast, agile, and stealthy when lightly loaded, these characteristics can suffer when carrying a heavy payload of weapons.

name: Fuel Container 10,000L
desc: An air transportable 10,000L fuel tank, commonly deployed at Forward Operating Bases.

name: Fuel Container 1500L
desc: A single use, air transportable 1,500L fuel tank, commonly deployed at Forward Operating Bases.

name: Fuel Container 6000L
desc: An air transportable 6,000L fuel tank, commonly deployed at Forward Operating Bases.

name: Fuel Depot
desc: Aviation fuel depot that can fill empty aircraft tanks within 300m.

name: Gabion Wall 10x1.5x1.5
desc: Entrenchment

name: Gabion Wall 20x3x3
desc: Entrenchment

name: GBM-500LR
desc: Upon arrival within 2.5km (1.6mi) of the designated target, this 500kg glide bomb dispenses 12 GS25 submunitions capable of independently finding and targeting hostile units in the vicinity.

name: GPO-2P Auger
desc: The Auger is a bunker busting gravity bomb with a precision guidance kit. It is capable of penetrating hardened structures before its large warhead detonates.

name: GPO-500
desc: Optically guided 500kg bomb, ideal for attacking convoys and large buildings.

name: GPO-N (1.5kt)
desc: Guided thermonuclear bomb, set to tactical yield. Detonates after a minimum time delay of 8 seconds, and when below 150m (500ft) altitude. For laydown delivery, it will deploy a parachute to allow the bomb to survive impact with the ground when dropped below 300m (1000ft).

name: GPO-N (250kt)
desc: Guided thermonuclear bomb, set to strategic yield. Detonates after a minimum time delay of 16 seconds, when below 500m (1650ft) altitude. Unless being lofted, level bombing should be carried out at a minimum of 1300m(4300ft).

name: Guard Tower
desc: An elevated, air conditioned chair for a human sentry. Reveals targets within a 5km radius, and will defend itself with small arms fire within a 1km radius.

name: Harbor Crane
desc: Structural element

name: Hardened Aircraft Shelter
desc: A reinforced hangar which stores fighter aircraft and a small complement of nuclear warheads. It is resistant to bombs and missiles, often requiring multiple direct hits or large/penetrating munitions to destroy it.

name: Helipad
desc: Takeoff point for VTOL aircraft

name: Hexhound GMG
desc: A Hexhound equipped with an automatic grenade launcher. The grenade launcher is able to rain indirect fire on datalink targets within 2km.

name: Hexhound SAM
desc: A Hexhound equipped with a four-shot IRM-S1 launcher. Its small profile makes it hard to detect, allowing it to ambush low flying air targets.

name: HLT Fire Control
desc: Command vehicle capable of distributing targets from a radar to individual SAM launchers in a battery

name: HLT Flatbed
desc: Logistics vehicle with a loading system capable of handling a variety of tasks

name: HLT Fuel Tanker
desc: Airbase support vehicle capable of refueling aircraft parked within 300m

name: HLT Munitions Truck
desc: Support vehicle capable of rearming friendly units within 300m

name: HLT Radar Truck
desc: Capable of tracking multiple aerial units at ranges of up to 100km (60m).

name: HLT Tractor
desc: Heavy duty tractor cab for hauling large trailer systems

name: HLT-CRAM
desc: This trailer is equipped with a 20mm rotary gun to provide point defence against shells, missiles, bombs, and low flying aircraft.

name: HLT-HEL
desc: A Laser Air Defence System capable of destroying small calibre aerial munitions.

name: Hull down circular
desc: Round rampart to provide cover for vehicles

name: Hull down square
desc: Square rampart to provide cover for vehicles

name: Hyperion Class Carrier
desc: The Hyperion class features a short take-off ramp and arrestor gear on its landing runway, and can accommodate a variety of aircraft types. Defended by two MMR-S3 batteries, one RAM-45 launcher, and two 30mm CIWS turrets, this fleet carrier is capable of countering most aerial threats.

name: Infantry Bunker
desc: A concealed front line fighting position of an infantry team armed with light machine guns, grenades, and rocket launchers. Capable of ambushing unsuspecting vehicles that enter its field of fire.

name: Infantry Squad
desc: Group of 8 troops which stay with the aircraft, providing the ability to capture buildings and airbases when landed nearby

name: IRM-S1
desc: Carried by air defense vehicles and light aircraft, this heat-seeking missile is effective against air targets at a range up to 5km

name: IRM-S1 Emplacement
desc: The IRM-S1 is a man-portable air defense system (MANPADS) effective at countering air threats within 5km. An infrared homing seeker allows the missile to lock onto any aerial target with a heat signature.

name: IRM-S2
desc: Short-range heat seeking missile ideal for attacking fast and maneuverable aircraft

name: KR-67 Ifrit
desc: A large, carrier capable, twin engine multirole fighter, the Ifrit is equally suited to air superiority and ground attack missions. It features excellent thrust and maneuverability alongside reduced radar signature and powerful sensors. Two internal weapon bays plus two additional side bays for heat-seeking missiles allow the Ifrit to carry a significant internal payload without impacting stealth or top speed.

name: Large Factory
desc: A vehicle manufacturing facility, housing a production line and its associated machinery. Factory buildings supply a specific type of vehicle to a faction's inventory.

name: Large Platform
desc: Structural element

name: LCV25 AA
desc: The LCV25 is a 4x4 all terrain vehicle, offered in AA or AT configurations, combining the agility of a light recon vehicle with the firepower of heavier fighting vehicles. It is air transportable, with 2 units fitting inside the cargo bay of a VL-49 Tarantula.

name: LCV25 AT
desc: The LCV25 is a 4x4 all terrain vehicle, offered in AA or AT configurations, combining the agility of a light recon vehicle with the firepower of heavier fighting vehicles. It is air transportable, with 2 units fitting inside the cargo bay of a VL-49 Tarantula.

name: LCV25 SAM
desc: The LCV25 is a 4x4 all terrain vehicle, offered in AA or AT configurations, combining the agility of a light recon vehicle with the firepower of heavier fighting vehicles. It is air transportable, with 2 units fitting inside the cargo bay of a VL-49 Tarantula.

name: LCV45 Recon Truck
desc: Though lightly armed and armored, the LCV45 is a fast vehicle ideal for forward scouting

name: Light Machine Gun
desc: Intermediate cartridge. It tickles.

name: Linebreaker APC
desc: An armored personnel carrier upfit for the Linebreaker chassis, this troop transport is well protected with good off-road mobility

name: Linebreaker IFV
desc: Sporting a powerful autocannon and anti-armor missiles, the Linebreaker Infantry Fighting Vehicle is a versatile unit capable of engaging both air and ground threats

name: Linebreaker SAM
desc: This armored air defense vehicle combines off-road mobility with 12 short-range IR missiles capable of engaging low-flying aircraft

name: M12 Jackknife
desc: A small, remote-controlled, air-transportable combat engineering unit designed for light role forces. Combat engineering units are able to facilitate the repair and reconstruction of hangars, helipads and vehicle depots.

name: Medium Aircraft Hangar
desc: Hangar for storing medium-sized aircraft

name: MLRS Rocket
desc: Long range artillery rocket with inertial navigation and terminal laser guidance to improve accuracy. A thermobaric warhead provides enhanced blast effects, ideal for demolishing buildings and defensive structures.

name: MMR-S3
desc: Medium-range heat seeking missile ideal for attacking fast and maneuverable aircraft

name: MSV Ballistic Missile Launcher
desc: Long range launcher armed with a pair of HE Piledrivers. Will deploy and fire automatically on known datalinked targets once the strategic escalation threshold is met.

name: MSV CRAM
desc: A Modular Support Vehicle equipped with a 20mm rotary gun to provide point defence against shells, missiles, bombs, and low flying aircraft.

name: MSV Fire Control
desc: Command vehicle capable of distributing targets from a radar to individual SAM launchers in a battery

name: MSV Flatbed
desc: Logistics vehicle with a loading system capable of handling a variety of tasks

name: MSV Fuel Tanker
desc: Airbase support vehicle capable of refueling aircraft parked within 300m

name: MSV LADS
desc: Modular Support Vehicle carrying a Laser Air Defence System capable of destroying small calibre aerial munitions.

name: MSV MRAP
desc: A lightly armed and armored personnel carrier built on the Modular Support Vehicle chassis

name: MSV Munitions
desc: Support vehicle capable of rearming friendly units within 300m

name: MSV Nuclear Ballistic Missile Launcher
desc: Long range launcher armed with a pair of 20kt Nuclear Piledrivers. Will deploy and fire automatically on known datalinked targets once the strategic escalation threshold is met.

name: MSV R9 Stratolance Launcher
desc: Long range air defense unit capable of engaging aerial targets detected by nearby radar trucks

name: MSV Radar
desc: Capable of tracking multiple aerial units at ranges of up to 100km (60m).

name: MSV Tractor
desc: Tractor unit for hauling trailer systems

name: Munitions Bunker
desc: Reinforced bunker for storing ammunition and nuclear warheads. Can resupply units within 300m. It is resistant to bombs and missiles, often requiring multiple direct hits or large/penetrating munitions to destroy it.

name: Munitions Container
desc: Allows continuous weapon rearmament for ground vehicles and aircraft within 100m. Avoid subjecting the container to large impact forces, as it may detonate.

name: Munitions Pallet
desc: Allows continuous weapon rearmament for ground vehicles and aircraft within 100m. Avoid subjecting the container to large impact forces, as it may detonate.

name: Naval Container
desc: Single-use container for replenishing a warship's ammunition stores. Has floatation devices and can be picked up by ships within 200m after being placed in the water.

name: Naval Supply Container
desc: A single 10-ton container for replenishing a warship's ammunition stores. Has floatation devices and can be picked up by ships within 200m after being placed in the water. Avoid subjecting the containers to large impact forces, as they may detonate.

name: Naval Supply Pallet
desc: Single-use pallet for replenishing a warship's ammunition stores. Has floatation devices and can be picked up by ships within 200m after being placed in the water.

name: NL-98
desc: A surface-launched active radar homing missile. Uses a combination of inertial guidance and terminal radar homing, and can be fired at aerial targets on datalink from beyond visual range.

name: OTB-31 landing craft
desc: Designed for rapidly delivering vehicles from Annex class assault carriers to landing points, this fast hovercraft can carry up to 80 tons of cargo and is equipped with an IRM-S1 launcher and heavy machine gun for self defense.

name: PAB-125
desc: A small optically guided 125kg bomb, ideal for destroying vehicles and small buildings in low level attacks.

name: PAB-125HD
desc: A high drag 125kg bomb, ideal for destroying vehicles in extremely low attacks.

name: PAB-250
desc: Optically guided 250kg bomb capable of destroying heavily armored vehicles and small buildings.

name: PAB-250LR
desc: Optically guided 250kg bomb, fitted with range extension kit to allow it to glide over long distances.

name: PAB-80LR
desc: This glide bomb deploys folding wings, giving it an extended range from altitude. Guided by an optical seeker during the terminal phase, the PAB-80LR features a small radar cross-section and no IR signature.

name: Piledriver TBM
desc: Designed for long-range precision strikes against high value targets, this tactical ballistic missile leaves the atmosphere before reentering on a steep trajectory, exceeding Mach 4 on impact. The Piledriver is virtually impossible to intercept without long range missile defenses in the vicinity of the target.

name: Piledriver TBM (20kt)
desc: Designed for long-range precision strikes against high value targets, this tactical ballistic missile leaves the atmosphere before reentering on a steep trajectory, exceeding Mach 4 on impact. The Piledriver is virtually impossible to intercept without long range missile defenses in the vicinity of the target.

name: Piledriver TBM (HE)
desc: Designed for long-range precision strikes against high value targets, this tactical ballistic missile leaves the atmosphere before reentering on a steep trajectory, exceeding Mach 4 on impact. The Piledriver is virtually impossible to intercept without long range missile defenses in the vicinity of the target.

name: Pillbox
desc: Designed to supplement and eventually replace human sentries, the pillbox represents part of a networked perimeter monitoring system. The hardened structure houses a pair of autonomous 12.7mm machine gun turrets.

name: Pipeline
desc: Structural element

name: Radar Container
desc: This transportable air defense radar unit can track multiple targets at ranges of up to 17km. It can be deployed by a utility aircraft and is able to provide target info to nearby SAM batteries.

name: Radar Jamming Pod
desc: Directional offensive jammer, capable of blinding one targeted radar per pod at ranges of up to 50km.

name: Radar Station
desc: Long-range sky scanning radar

name: Radome
desc: Powerful long-range all-aspect radar, capable of spotting aircraft even at altitudes as low as 5m (16ft)

name: RAM-45
desc: Vertically launched missile effective against aerial radar returns at a range up to 15km

name: RAM45 Launcher
desc: A single RAM45 launcher turret.

name: Refinery Structure
desc: Synthetic fuel production unit capable of converting a large variety of organic feedstocks into fertilizer and combustible fuels.

name: Ring D50m
desc: Structural element

name: SAH-46 Chicane
desc: The SAH-46 Chicane retains a traditional attack helicopter configuation while incorporating upgrades that keep it a formidable presence on the battlefield of the late 21st Century. Cutting edge stealth technology allows the Chicane to conduct pop-up attacks from behind terrain and disappear from radar without a trace.

name: SFB-81 Darkreach
desc: Featuring powerful engines, a stealthy silhouette, and 4 large internal weapon bays, the SFB-81 Darkreach is a formidable bomber capable of deploying both conventional and nuclear weapons. Its blended wing design allows the Darkreach to conduct operations in a variety of flight regimes, from low-altitude penetrating strikes to standoff strategic bombardment.

name: Shard Class Corvette
desc: This compact warship is well equipped for defending coastal areas, armed with a 57mm cannon, 20mm point defense system, and battery of vertically launched RAM-45 missiles. A small landing pad at the stern allows it to serve as a mobile re-arming and refueling point for helicopters.

name: Sloped Platform
desc: Structural element

name: Small Munitions Pallet
desc: Allows continuous weapon rearmament for ground vehicles and aircraft within 100m. Avoid subjecting the container to large impact forces, as it may detonate.

name: Small Platform
desc: Structural element

name: Small Platform Columns
desc: Structural element

name: Solar Panels
desc: Solar Panels

name: Spearhead MBT
desc: With a liberal application of armour and weapon modules, the latest iterations of the Spearhead are as protected as they are powerful. The combination of 130mm main gun and ATGM launcher allow it to hold its own against larger numbers of enemy armoured units, while the roof mounted 20kw pulse laser can protect the relatively thinner top armour against missiles. Its ever-growing list of capabilities has come with a diminished top speed and a total weight far exceeding its original design specifications.

name: Storage Tank
desc: Refrigerated, in-ground bulk liquid gas storage. Thick concrete for insulation makes it difficult to damage with weapons fire.

name: StratoLance R9
desc: Long range ground launched semi-active radar homing missile

name: StratoLance R9 Launcher
desc: Long range air defense trailer capable of engaging aerial targets detected by nearby radar trucks

name: Surf Class Patrol Boat
desc: The Surf Class is an inshore patrol vessel, nominally used for border protection and anti-piracy duties. While it lacks the staying power of larger ships, its speed and complement of vertically launched AGM-48s can make it a credible threat to them. The 30mm main gun has proximity fused shells and provides some amount of self-protection against missile attack.

name: T9K41 Boltstrike
desc: This formidable anti-air unit incorporates a radar capable of tracking multiple aerial targets at a range of up to 15km, and carries 16 vertical-launch missiles which can be fired in rapid succession

name: Tower Crane
desc: Structural element

name: Truss 50m
desc: Structural element

name: Tusko-B (HE)
desc: Long-range anti-surface missile employing a quasi-ballistic trajectory, allowing it to reach distant targets at supersonic speeds.

name: Type-12 MBT
desc: While the Type 12 may be a legacy design, it still remains a formidable presence on the battlefield. It offers better protection per unit weight than its contemporaries, owing to its novel monocoque composite hull & turret that give the Type-12 its signature shape. Its armament consists of a 130mm cannon firing hypervelocity SABOT rounds and a turreted 12.7mm machine gun.

name: UH-90 Ibis
desc: Designed for a PALA fast vertical lift program in the 2050s, the UH-90 was conceptualized as a medium-sized compound utility helicopter, but has since been fitted with numerous weapon stations allowing it to occupy a gunship role. Featuring a coaxial rigid rotor system and two reversible turbine-electric ducted fans in pusher configuration, the Ibis can rapidly reach high cruising speeds before decelerating to a vertical landing in less than 30 seconds.

name: Vehicle Depot
desc: Vehicle deployment facility. Can defend itself with small arms fire.

name: Vertical Factory
desc: A low-footprint vehicle manufacturing facility, housing an entirely automated production chain. Lighting, heating, and floorspace requirements are only considered for the handful of quality assurance workers overseeing the facility. Factory buildings supply a specific type of vehicle to a faction's inventory.

name: VT-7 Vagrant
desc: Featuring a unique 3-post ducted thrust system, this trainer doubles as an affordable attack aircraft with VTOL capability. The Vagrant is highly maneuverable and capable of transonic speeds, while also featuring a radar to allow engagement of air targets at beyond visual range. Although lacking advanced stealth features, the VT-7 continues to serve as the backbone of BDF naval aviation.
